agent.problem: The walkthrough never tells Onan's actual action in verse 9: whenever he slept with Tamar, he spilled his seed on the ground. Cards 8-10 give only his knowledge and the result that no offspring was produced, then refer to "what Onan did" without explaining the deed. This omits a central detail and leaves verse 10 less clear.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
